title: Kimchi Jjigae
description: A bubbling, sour-spicy stew of old kimchi and pork belly with soft tofu. The dish that uses up a jar that has gone too far.
notes: Tinned tuna in place of the pork is a classic, cheaper version.

ingredients.name: well-fermented kimchi
ingredients.note: chopped, plus 60 ml of its juice

steps.text: Fry the pork belly in a pot until it renders some fat, then add the kimchi and cook until it softens and darkens.
steps.tip: Old, sour kimchi is the point. If yours is young, add a splash of rice vinegar.

steps.text: Stir in the gochugaru, gochujang, sugar, and garlic, then add the kimchi juice and water.
Cover and simmer so the kimchi gives up its flavour to the broth.
Slide in the tofu and simmer until heated through. Finish with green onions and sesame oil and serve bubbling, with rice.
